"""FuzzExecutor frame conversion and execution against an injected transport.

The adapter converts typed payload frames into decoded client actions, drives
them on the offline clock and encodes exact per-case receipts: 8-byte big-endian
virtual time, 4-byte big-endian stream id, one ASCII kind byte, the encoded
content and one final end byte.  Header content is an 8-byte pair count followed
by 8-byte name length, name bytes, 8-byte value length and value bytes per
pair; data content is an 8-byte length followed by the data bytes.
"""
from schema import H3HeaderFrame, H3DataFrame, H3SleepFrame
from HTTP3_Just_Send import HttpClient
from modules.clock import Clock
from modules.events import HeadersReceived, DataReceived, ConnectionTerminated, SendError
from modules.byte_program import literal, concat, fingerprint, size


def encoded_action(at, stream, kind, data, end=False):
    head = literal(at.to_bytes(8,'big')+stream.to_bytes(4,'big')+kind.encode('ascii'))
    if kind in ('H','h'):
        head = concat(head,literal(len(data).to_bytes(8,'big')))
        for name,value in data:
            head = concat(head,literal(size(name).to_bytes(8,'big')))
            head = concat(head,name)
            head = concat(head,literal(size(value).to_bytes(8,'big')))
            head = concat(head,value)
    else:
        head = concat(head,literal(size(data).to_bytes(8,'big')))
        head = concat(head,data)
    return concat(head,literal(bytes([bool(end)])))


class OfflineTransport:
    def __init__(self, clock, count):
        self.clock = clock
        self.next_stream = 0
        self.ended = set()
        self.sent = [None]*count
        self.frames = [0]*count
        self.request_frames = [0]*count
        self.payload_bytes = [0]*count
        self.client = None

    def get_next_available_stream_id(self):
        stream = self.next_stream
        self.next_stream += 4
        return stream

    def record(self, stream_id, kind, data, end_stream=False):
        if stream_id in self.ended:
            raise SendError('frame after request end')
        index = stream_id//4
        action = encoded_action(self.clock.now,stream_id,kind,data,end_stream)
        self.sent[index] = concat(self.sent[index],action)
        self.frames[index] += 1
        if kind in ('H','D'):
            self.request_frames[index] += 1
        self.payload_bytes[index] += sum(size(n)+size(v) for n,v in data) if kind=='H' else size(data)
        if end_stream:
            self.ended.add(stream_id)

    def send_headers(self, stream_id, headers, end_stream):
        self.record(stream_id,'H',headers,end_stream)

    def send_data(self, stream_id, data, end_stream):
        self.record(stream_id,'D',data,end_stream)

    def send_datagram(self, stream_id, data):
        self.record(stream_id,'G',data)

    def dispatch(self, record):
        if record['kind']=='close':
            self.client.quic_event_received(ConnectionTerminated())
        elif record['kind']=='headers':
            self.client.quic_event_received(HeadersReceived(record['stream'],record['fields'],record['end']))
        else:
            self.client.quic_event_received(DataReceived(record['stream'],record['data'],record['end']))


class FuzzExecutor:
    def __init__(self, target_ip=None, target_port=None, domain=None):
        self.target_ip = target_ip
        self.target_port = target_port
        self.domain = domain

    def _convert_single_case_frames(self, frames):
        converted_frames = []
        for item in frames:
            if isinstance(item, H3SleepFrame):
                converted_frames.append({'Type': 'sleep',
                                         'Time_to_Stop': item.Time_to_Stop})
            elif isinstance(item, H3HeaderFrame):
                converted_frames.append({'Type': 'headers',
                                         'data_to_transfered': item.data_to_transfered,
                                         'End_Stream': item.End_Stream})
            elif isinstance(item, H3DataFrame):
                converted_frames.append({'Type': item.Type,
                                         'data_to_transfered': item.data_to_transfered,
                                         'End_Stream': item.End_Stream})
            else:
                raise ValueError('frame model')
        return converted_frames

    def send_payload(self, payload, records, timeout_ms):
        items = list(payload.test_cases.items())
        clock = Clock()
        transport = OfflineTransport(clock, len(items))
        client = HttpClient(clock, transport, timeout_ms)
        transport.client = client
        coroutines = []
        for index, (case_name, frames) in enumerate(items):
            converted = self._convert_single_case_frames(frames)
            coroutines.append(client.request(converted, index))
        results = clock.run(coroutines, records, transport.dispatch)
        out = []
        for index, (case_name, frames) in enumerate(items):
            result = results[index]
            received = None
            body = None
            for at, event in result['events']:
                if isinstance(event, HeadersReceived):
                    encoded = encoded_action(at, result['stream'], 'h',
                                             event.headers, event.stream_ended)
                else:
                    encoded = encoded_action(at, result['stream'], 'd',
                                             event.data, event.stream_ended)
                    body = concat(body, event.data)
                received = concat(received, encoded)
            out.append({'name': case_name, 'stream': result['stream'],
                'state': result['state'], 'at': result['at'],
                'frames': transport.frames[index],
                'request_frames': transport.request_frames[index],
                'payload_bytes': transport.payload_bytes[index],
                'sent': fingerprint(transport.sent[index]),
                'received': fingerprint(received),
                'response_frames': len(result['events']),
                'response_body': fingerprint(body),
                'origin_count': 0, 'flags': []})
        return out
